review.summary: F-001 is fixed: build-release refuses any folder not directly under SCHATTEN_SOURCES_DIR, and the harness covers it. The same branch extends the review-record validator to TASK-XXXA1 IDs with a test and schema documentation, recorded in the task file. No new issues were found.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: build-release now resolves SCHATTEN_SOURCES_DIR after load_config and refuses a source folder whose parent is not that directory. The harness shows that a self-consistent read-only copy outside it passes --verify but is refused by build-release, and the unverified-folder case now runs inside the sources directory. The Engine 28.5.2 harness passed on a tree identical to this commit apart from QA documentation.
